Reviewed `hooks/games/pet.ts`, `hooks/register.tsx`, `hooks/hooks.json` and
`hooks/boards/pet.tsx`. OmniCore adapts the initial XP/mood awards, inactivity
floor and square-root level formula. The classifier, weighted incubation,
durability/protocol integration and all six pixel silhouettes are original.
The reference's hook/rendering source and ASCII art are not copied into the product.
